opportunities.title: Small grants

amount.raw: Awards generally fall in a range of £1,500-£5,000 and will only exceptionally exceed £6,000; travel grants up to £2,000/£2,500 per person; PhD fieldwork visits of six months or more up to £5,000; Japan office up to ¥300,000 for PhD travel to the UK

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution willing to receive grant funds. Applications are not accepted from individuals for personal projects. No support for undergraduate or master's students, student fees, or travel connected with study for a qualification (excluding PhD students).
opportunities.summary: Seed funding to enable UK-Japan projects that might otherwise not be possible. Supports festivals, workshops, performances, exchanges, collaborative projects, Japanese language and cultural studies, and academic research/visits that bring people in the UK and Japan together and deepen mutual understanding. Three annual UK award meetings and two annual Japan office award meetings.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: Up to £10,000; continuing projects lasting up to three years to a maximum of £10,000 per year, to a total limit of £30,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally show an existing research record, though consideration is given to practitioners, managers, carers and others in health-related fields. Projects must involve partners in both the UK and Japan, be supported by reputable referees not based at the same institution as either partner, and provide evidence of host facilities. Preference to those not previously involved in UK-Japan collaboration and early-career applicants.
opportunities.summary: Annual awards supporting exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, including study of scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare. Grants may be used for travel expenses, conference and publication costs. Deadline moved from 15 December to 1 December from 2026. Registered as an NIHR Non-commercial Partner organisation.
